column5: homograph trap cleared: NOT "классический" — դասական թվական = ordinal numeral
homograph trap cleared: locative of տարբերակ, NOT verbal noun of տարբերակել
sense trap: kaikki's "summary" sense is wrong here; syllable contraction/haplology
register trap: standalone "флективный" reads as language typology; context = inflected forms
wording: coalescence of sounds, not flat "совпадение"
abbreviation convention gloss; source stays prior (expansion asserted, not corpus-verified)
set-phrase context "արտասանության տեղ" = place of articulation; gloss must carry артикуляция
homonym clash cleared: highlighted ալանի = անալի "unsalted" (block says «ոչ աղի իմաստով»); the footnote's ալանի (a dried-fruit sweet) is the excluded reading
hl homograph guard: surface մեր here is colloquial for մայր, NOT the possessive "our"; hl rows must never lemma-match as the pronoun
